descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S01 「OAT-04 第 1–2 步照原文跑（医院）：七个变老的项各在自己的窗口删掉，查询时已经不在」 OAT-04 steps 1-2 as written (Hospital): seven aged items each deleted at its window, queryable as gone

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden …（UAT OAT-04；UAT OAT-04 step 2；TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-92568 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 Hospital pre-round text clears at 12 h: pre-round text seeded at 13 h is deleted.（UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: pre-round text 12 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U3 Hospital Important Points clear at 12 h: an Important Point seeded at 13 h is deleted.（UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: Important Points 12 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Handoffs are deleted 36 h after they were sent: a handoff sent 37 h ago is gone from the database, for sender and recipient alike.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: handoffs 36 h after sent)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with two synthetic Hospital patients and one colleague account. Through the aging helper, on patient A: pre-round text processed 13 h ago, an Important Point written 13 h ago, a vital and a lab last refreshed 37 h ago, an active medication row last mentioned 37 h ago, a held medication ro …

When The purge runs (the server job; on main only rounding:applyLifecycle exists), then the raw documents are read with admin access

Then Each of the seven aged items on patient A is absent from the database (field or row gone, no flag holding the value); the 37 h handoff's text and patient content are gone (what may remain is Q20); every control item on patient B, a 1 h handoff and both roster entries are untouched

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per item, from UAT OAT-04 step 2 / Expected 1 and TFA-94699 AC 1: absent from the raw document or table = pass for that item; present in any form (including a hidden or flagged copy) = Fail; a control item missing = Fail (deleted too early). Handoff: its text and every patient's content in it absent = pass; …

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92568 in progress；TFA-94699 in progress

写了 13 小时的 Important Point 还在病历上，37 小时的未完成任务还在任务列表里，37 小时前发的交接发件人和收件人都还能完整看到。

13 h after it was written an Important Point is still on the chart, a 37 h-old open task is still in the task list, and a handoff sent 37 h ago is still fully readable by sender and recipient.

依据：allure 9ce53c58-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/retention. 14 checks pass, 3 fail, all known: K1 (points clear at 18 h on one clock), K2 (open tasks never purged), K3 (handoffs never purged). Q20 (what of a handoff may remain) is recorded only. The ticket in progress, TFA-94699, covers exactly these windows.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane retention：retention/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（retention/plan.json，automatable: yes）：API spec: fresh physician + fresh colleague; patient A split in two charts so every 'given' holds at once (A-short: pre-round processed 13 h, point 13 h; A-long: vital + lab + active row + held row + open task with chart last processed 37 h); control B with every item 1 h old; handoff 37 h and control handoff 1 h (sentAt set by the helper). Purge, then raw rows by admin read; handoff judged on text/patient content per Q20. — All items can be written through the app's own mutations and aged by the helper; the purge is the app's own function.
